y-m-05-02.title: Zingaphi iindlela zokusebenzisa zonke iintonga?

Iintonga ezisetyenziselwa umo omnye zisetyenziselwa loo mo kuphela (akukho ntonga ibelwanayo nezinye iimilo). Ufuna ukusebenzisa zonke iintonga ezingama-31 ungashiyi nanye, wenze unxantathu o-1 ubuncinane nekwadrilatharali e-1 ubuncinane.

y-m-05-03.title: Zingaphi iibhloko zokwakha ukuba sibona ngaphambili kuphela?
y-m-05-03.goal: Qonda ukuba inani eliphelele leebhloko zokwakha alinakumiselwa ngokujonga ngaphambili kuphela, uze wazifumanele ulwazi olukuvumela ukulimisela namanani anokwenzeka.
y-m-05-03.material: Iibhloko zokwakha zizikhyubhu zomthi zobungakanani obufanayo. Kukho iindawo ezi-3 ecaleni kwecala ukusuka ekhohlo ukuya ekunene. Kumqolo wangaphambili, indawo esekhohlo inebhloko ezi-2 (amanqanaba ama-2), indawo esembindini inebhloko e-1, yaye indawo esekunene inebhloko e-1, ngoko umqolo wangaphambili unebhloko ezi-4 ngokupheleleyo. Xa kujongwa ngaphambili, kubonakala ngathi zizinyathelo, icala lasekhohlo liphezulu ngenqanaba elinye. Kunokubakho umqolo ongasemva emva komqolo wangaphambili, kodwa fihlwe ngumqolo wangaphambili yaye awubonakali. Ukuba kukho umqolo ongasemva, indawo nganye ibekwe ingeniphezulu kunendawo efanayo emqolweni wangaphambili (ukuba iphezulu, ungayibona ngaphambili). Iibhloko azibhabhi emoyeni, yaye kukho imiqolo emibini kuphela, umqolo wangaphambili nomqolo ongasemva.

y-m-05-05.title: Ngaba ukunqumla kanye kuya kuhlala kwenza unxantathu?
y-m-05-05.goal: Bonisa ngomzekelo omnye ochasayo ukuba intetho ethi "Ukuba unqumla ikwere kanye ngomgca othe ngqo, unxantathu uyavela ngokuqinisekileyo" ayilunganga, uze uyilungise ukuze ilunge.
y-m-05-05.material: Kukho ikwere yephepha elinemibala enemiphetho eyi-6cm. Udibanisa ichaphazelo P kwicala eliphezulu nechaphazelo Q kwicala eliphantsi ngomgca othe ngqo uze unqumle. Ichaphazelo P liyi-x cm ekunene kwesiphelo sasekhohlo secala eliphezulu, yaye ichaphazelo Q liyi-y cm ekunene kwesiphelo sasekhohlo secala eliphantsi. I-x ne-y ngamanani emvelo ukusuka kwi-0cm ukuya kwi-6cm, yaye ukuba ngu-0cm okanye 6cm, ichaphazelo likwisiphelo somphetho (incopho). USeoyun wathi, "Ukuba unqumla ikwere kanye ngomgca othe ngqo, esinye seziqwenga siba nguxantathu ngokuqinisekileyo."

y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Idesika 가 ibonakala ide ngakumbi, kodwa asiqinisekanga.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Le ngcinga igcina isigwebo sokuqala kodwa iyancitshiswa indlela oqinisekile ngayo.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Asikwazi ukuxela. Asazi ubude beminwe yabantu ababini.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Le ngcinga ibona ukuba amaxabiso alinganiswe ngemilinganiselo eyahlukileyo awanakuthelekiswa.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Le ngcinga iguqule isigwebo sokuqala emva kokubona ulwazi olutsha, kodwa kunzima ukunika isizathu soko.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Umnwe kaGaeun ngu-9cm, kwaye umnwe kaNarae ngu-13cm.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kwenzeka ntoni xa ubonisa ubude bamadesika amabini nge-cm uze uwathelekise?
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.after: Idesika 가 yi-9+9+9+9=36cm kwaye idesika 나 yi-13+13+13=39cm. Nokuba iminwe imbalwa, ukuba umnwe ngamnye mde, loo desika inokuba yinde ngakumbi.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Le ngcinga iqikelele ukuba umahluko wobude bomnwe ulingana nomahluko wenani leminwe.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Le ngcinga icinga ukuba enemiyonwe emininzi isayinde ngakumbi.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Le ngcinga ifumene ubude bedesika nganye nge-cm yaza yathelekisa.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.reflect: Xa umntu omnye elinganise, sasinokuthelekisa ngenani leminwe. Kodwa xa abantu abahlukeneyo balinganise ngeminwe yabo, kwakunzima ukuthi ngokuqinisekileyo. Sinokuthelekisa kuphela emva kokuba sazi ubude bomnwe omnye kwiyunithi efanayo (cm).
y-m-05-06.s.s2.prompt: Ukuba idesika 가 (iminwe emi-4) nedesika 나 (iminwe emi-3) zinobude obufanayo, fumana amabini amathathu ahlukeneyo amaxabiso omnwe kaGaeun a cm nomnwe kaNarae b cm. (Iminwe yabo bobabini ziinani zemvelo ezisuka kwi-8cm ukuya kwi-20cm.)
y-m-05-06.s.s2.hint.0: Misela a, ufumane ukuba iminwe emi-4 kaGaeun ingaphi i-cm, uze ufumane b eyenza iminwe emi-3 kaNarae ibe nobude obufanayo.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.hint.1: Khangela ukuba b linani lemvelo kwaye ayidluli kwi-20.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Iminwe yabo bobabini ziinani zemvelo ezisuka kwi-8cm ukuya kwi-20cm.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Umnwe kufuneka ube linani lemvelo elisuka kwi-8cm ukuya kwi-20cm.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Ubude bamadesika amabini abufani. Fumana ukuba iminwe emi-4 kaGaeun neminwe emi-3 kaNarae ingaphi i-cm, uze uyithelekise.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.explain: Ukuba umnwe kaGaeun ungu-9cm kwaye kaNarae ungu-12cm, omabini angama-36cm, afanayo. 12cm no-16cm (48cm), kunye no-15cm no-20cm (60cm) nazo zinokwenzeka. Phakathi kwe-8cm ne-20cm, ezi zintathu ziwodwa kuphela.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Bhala isizathu sokuba amadesika amabini abe nobude obufanayo nangona amanani eminwe ahlukile, 4 no-3.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Khetha ibini elinye owalifumana ngasentla ubeke umnwe kaGaeun nomnwe kaNarae secaleni.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba umnwe unjani kowalinganise amaxesha ambalwa.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uthe umnwe womntu omnye mde ngakumbi?
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uthe ukuze ubude bufane, owalinganise amaxesha ambalwa kufuneka abe nomnwe ongade ngakumbi?
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Umnwe kaNarae mde kuneKaGaeun, ngoko nokuba ulinganisa amaxesha ama-3 kuphela kunokunika ubude obufanayo noGaeun olinganisa amaxesha ama-4.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Ukuba umnwe kaGaeun ungu-9cm kwaye umnwe kaNarae ungu-12cm, ukudibanisa u-9 amaxesha ama-4 no-12 amaxesha ama-3 zombini zinika i-36cm, ezifanayo. Ukuba umnwe mkhulu, ukulinganisa okumbalwa kunokunika ubude obufanayo.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.2: Ubude beminwe buyahluka komntu ngomntu, ngoko ukuba umnwe kaNarae mde, ubude obufanayo bufuna iminwe embalwa.

y-m-05-07.title: Singawabala njani onxantathu ekwere ngaphandle kokushiya nawuphi?
y-m-05-07.goal: Thelekisa iindlela zokubala onxantathu abakhulu nabancinci emfanekisweni ngaphandle kokushiya nawuphi okanye ukubala nawuphi kabini, ulungise ukubala okungalunganga, wenze indlela yakho yokubala yomfanekiso owahlukileyo.
y-m-05-07.material: Uqala ngasekhohlo phezulu uhamba ngokujikeleza kweyure, biza iincopho ezine zephepha elikwere ngokuthi ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, no-ㄹ. Dibanisa ㄱ no-ㄷ kunye no-ㄴ no-ㄹ ngemigca ethe ngqo, kwaye imigca emibini idibana kwichaphaza eliphakathi ㅁ. Sifuna ukubala bonke onxantathu abakhulu nabancinci abanokufunyanwa kulo mfanekiso. Onke amacala amathathu onxantathu kufuneka alale kwimigca ezotyiweyo emfanekisweni. (ㄱ ifundwa giyeok, ㄴ ifundwa nieun, ㄷ ifundwa digeut, ㄹ ifundwa rieul, kwaye ㅁ ifundwa mieum.)
y-m-05-07.prereq.0: Ukwazi ukuba unxantathu yimilo ejikelezwe yimigca emi-3 ethe ngqo (inqanaba loMgangatho wesi-2)
y-m-05-07.prereq.1: Ukubala nokudibanisa amanani angama-10 okanye ukujikelezela kuwo
y-m-05-07.s.s1.prompt: Abahlobo abane bachaze indlela ababala ngayo onxantathu. Khetha zonke iindlela ezinokubala bonke onxantathu ngaphandle kokushiya nawuphi okanye ukubala nawuphi kabini.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.hint.0: Kwindlela nganye, cinga ukuba bangawaphi onxantathu abangashiywa.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.hint.1: Jonga ukuba onxantathu abaliwe ngendlela nganye bangahlulwa ngaphandle kokugqitha.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.o.a: Seojin: Bala kuphela onxantathu abancinci kakhulu.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.r.a: Le ngcinga ayibali onxantathu abakhulu abenziwe ngokudibanisa onxantathu ababini abancinci.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.o.b: Daon: Qala ubale abancinci, emva koko ubale abo benziwe ngabancinci ababini abadityanisiweyo.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.r.b: Le ngcinga ihlele ngobukhulu yabala ngokulandelelana.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.o.c: Hajun: Khetha amachaphaza ama-3 kwangama-5 ngexesha, kodwa shiya amachaphaza amathathu asemgceni omnye othe ngqo.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.r.c: Le ngcinga ibala ngaphandle kokushiya nawuphi ngokukhetha amachaphaza, yaye ihlela amatyala angenzi nxantathu.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.o.d: Yuna: Bala nantoni na ebamba iliso.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.r.d: Le ngcinga ayinalandelelwano okanye mthetho, ngoko inokushiya ezinye okanye ibale ezinye kabini.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.explain: Ukubala ngokulandelelana ngobukhulu, nokukhetha amachaphaza ama-3 ngexesha ngelixa kushiywa amachaphaza amathathu asemgceni omnye othe ngqo, zombini zinokubala bonke onxantathu. Ukubala kuphela abancinci kakhulu, okanye ukubala nantoni na ebamba iliso, kunokushiya ezinye.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.acc.0: Indlela kaDaon inokubala bonke. Indlela kaHajun inokubala bonke nayo.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.acc.1: Indlela kaHajun inokubala bonke. Indlela kaDaon inokubala bonke nayo.
y-m-05-07.s.s2.prompt: UMinu wakhetha amachaphaza ama-3 kwangama-5 ngexesha wabala onxantathu. Khetha umgca wokuqala ongalunganga. (Bala imigca uqala ngenani 1.)
y-m-05-07.s.s2.hint.0: Khangela enye ngenye ukuba oko kubaliweyo okanye kukhethiweyo kumgca ngamnye kuba ngunxantathu ngokwenene emfanekisweni.
y-m-05-07.s.s2.hint.1: Khangela ukuba amanani ekudibaniseni komgca wokugqibela ayahambelana nemigca yangaphambili.

y-m-05-07.s.s2.explain: Iqala ukuphosakala kumgca wesi-3. ㄱ, ㅁ, no-ㄷ zisemgceni omnye othe ngqo (idayagonali), ngoko azenzi nxantathu. Ngesizathu esifanayo ㄴ, ㅁ, no-ㄹ kufuneka nazo zishiywe, ngoko kukho onxantathu abayi-8 bonke. I-9 kumgca wesi-4 ayilunganga kuba sisigqibo esiqhubeka nempazamo yomgca wesi-3.
